title: Studio page block inspector: InspectorJsonField's Label is not associated with its textarea, so curated JSON props have no accessible name
body:
## Observed

In `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/PageBlockInspector.tsx`, `InspectorJsonField` renders a `Label` as a sibling of its textarea with no `htmlFor` / `id` pairing. Every curated JSON prop of a page block (for example `record:related_list`'s `add`, and the `sort` / `columns` JSON fallback for a stored union arm) therefore exposes a textarea with no accessible name. testing-library reports it as `Found a label with the text of: Sort, however no form control was found associated to that label`.

## Reach

Public door: Studio → page designer → block inspector, any block prop drawn by `InspectorJsonField`. Screen readers announce an unnamed text box; `getByLabelText` cannot target the field in tests.

## Expected

`Label htmlFor` ↔ textarea `id` (or `aria-labelledby`), the same pairing the inspector's other rows use; one pin that queries the field by its label.

## Dedupe words

InspectorJsonField label htmlFor textarea accessible name PageBlockInspector

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from PR #27163's out-of-scope findings (class a, reach measured), under epic #26676.</sub>
